title: Arrowtown, New Zealand | Queenstown Official Website
facts: The official tourism guide identifies Arrowtown as a historic nearby settlement with heritage, walking and visitor attractions.
Arrowtown is beside the Arrow River and is associated with the nineteenth-century Otago gold rush.
The tourism office recommends the Lakes District Museum and the Chinese Village for heritage interpretation.
The official guide describes autumn foliage in April and May and public transport options; current timetables must be checked.
